title: NightWatch Session
description: A QA session: one testing goal, investigation or retest engagement (hours to days). State machine source: §7.2. 'blocked' is a recoverable state entered from running. Session revisions create a new object with a parent reference (never mutate history).

goal.description: Current session goal (what the user authorized this session to achieve).

authorization_boundary.description: User-authorized boundary for this session (what is allowed, what is explicitly out of scope).

environment.description: Confirmed target environment name (set once reaching environment_ready).

blocked_reason.description: Mandatory when state=blocked: why the session is blocked (missing credential, external wait, etc.).
